newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - AECI half year shr rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - AECI half year shr rises.

text.p: Analysts polled by Reuters forecast earnings per share on a range of 99.6 cents to 107.0, with consensus at 102.1. The dividend was seen in a 33.0 cents to 34.0 band, averaging at 33.2.
NOTE - AECI said general improvement in trading conditions which began in the second quarter last year was not sustained through the second quarter of 1997.

It added that prospects for the balance of the year have also been impaired by the current slowdown in the domestic economy and prevailing weakness in global markets for nitrogen fertilizers. Nonetheless, provided interest rates are soon allowed to reflect the lower levels of economic activity and given reasonable agricultural conditions, the group remains well positioned to achieve real growth in earnings for the year, AECI said.
